description: The dynamic value for a dynamic pseudo-type parameter accepting unknowns gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec forces the call's result type to the dynamic pseudo-type, and then, because the parameter accepts unknowns, uses the function's result value, a tuple holding the dynamic value. That contradicts itself, since the only values of the dynamic pseudo-type are its null and the dynamic value, so the spec doesn't decide the result. go-cty doesn't call the function for the dynamic value when its parameter doesn't accept the dynamic pseudo-type, whatever the parameter's other flags, and returns the dynamic value (Function.Call in cty/function/function.go).
